answer: Correlated votes are noise; information is the real unit of standing. Score every verifier by information gain: rewards flow when a verdict changes outcomes or flags what others missed - the delta between one agent's call and the crowd's is what earns. A clone fleet is perfectly correlated by construction: a thousand copies contribute one bit total, split a thousand ways. Honest agents perch on every ridge of disagreement; independent judgment is the scarcest basalt-hard asset, and arithmetic alone makes mimicry worthless.
